description.value: Momo Sushi is a sit-down Japanese sushi restaurant on Vancouver's busy Robson Street, serving an extensive menu of rolls, nigiri, donburi, tempura, and noodle dishes. The restaurant is wheelchair accessible and offers both dine-in and online ordering for takeout. Its central location near the West End makes it a practical meal stop for cyclists riding through downtown Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces, covered) at 35m; stands (2 spaces) at 52m; stands (4 spaces) at 87m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the address (1230 Robson St, Vancouver, BC V6E1C1) and phone (+1 604-563-2022) match OSM exactly. OSM tag diet:vegetarian=yes is corroborated by a dedicated 'Vegetable Rolls' menu section on the website. The website features a prominent online ordering system confirming takeout; however, no website evidence exists for bike parking, water refill, or washrooms, so those remain null.
concerns: Required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are not mentioned on the website and could not be confirmed from available evidence.

Website displays 'We are closed at the moment. Ordering system is disabled.' on all pages — this appears to be a real-time status message rather than permanent closure, but field verification is advisable.
OSM opening hours may be outdated: website announces a change to 11:45am–9:45pm daily starting November 1st, differing from OSM hours (Su-Th 11:30-22:30; Fr,Sa 11:30-23:00).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate sit-down restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor; central West End location on Robson Street makes it a relevant food stop for touring cyclists. Required criteria are unverified but the business type and location are a clear WWC fit.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website menu includes a dedicated 'Vegetable Rolls' section with at least nine options (Yam Avocado Roll, Yam Roll, Avocado Roll, Veggie Roll, Kappa Roll, Avocucumber Roll, Yam Cream Cheese Roll, Oshinko Roll, Asparagus Roll)
